proposals.quote: The nurse reviews a commercial driver's symptoms alongside information from a witness, the treating team and an older workplace form, because each source describes a different part of the story; the occupational record retains those differences and identifies completed current findings without turning a booking, a family account or a recollection into a measured patient result.
